name: Toy validation site
app_type: static five-page fixture (signup, widgets, settings, archive)
summary: Five-page static fixture used as the project's labelled ground truth.
notes: Mechanically extracted from static HTML by intake/extract.py. No LLM, no hand-authored content, no behaviours. On a static site the markup is also the runtime DOM, so many of these rules are visible to the judge through the window as well; this profile is not evidence about server-side intent.

rules.rule: the form declares novalidate, so the browser will not enforce the field constraints above; anything enforcing them has to be the application itself
must be a valid email, is required
must be a valid number, must be between 13 and 120
